references.text: The instruction to wash the garment with leprosy-like spots, which is the basis for the second washing mentioned in verse 58.
Describes what the priest should do if the spot has faded after washing—tear out the affected part before the garment can be declared clean.
A parallel cleansing process for leprous persons that also includes washing clothes and repeated purification to be declared clean.
A similar principle of washing clothes to achieve purity, which applies when coming into contact with unclean things.
Instructions on cleansing objects through water, including garments that must be washed to become clean.
